hints.title: What path passes through a node?
hints.body: A path through a node uses one downward path in the left subtree and one in the right subtree.

hints.title: Height and diameter together
hints.body: The best path through a node has length `leftHeight + rightHeight`.

hints.title: Bottom-up
hints.body: Each subtree reports its height; the parent updates the global diameter with the sum of its children's heights.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
best = 0
measure(node):
    if node is null: return 0
    left = measure(node.left)
    right = measure(node.right)
    best = max(best, left + right)
    return 1 + max(left, right)
return best
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
